The name's Sir Fuzzington. A gentleman, as you've probably gathered. Well spoken, well dressed, and rather particular about tone. By daylight, I believe in order. Proper manners. British stacks. Everything exactly where it ought to be. But every now and then... one must remind the room who's in charge. That's when the Crown comes out. Do make yourself comfortable. We've a great deal of noise to make. PRE-ORDER Sir Fuzzington Sir Fuzzington Drive is a British Marshall Stack & Vintage Fuzz Dual drive Pedal On one side, a disciplined British Marshall stack-inspired circuit—tight, articulate, and always in control. On the other, a classic fuzz voice—bold, expressive, and unapologetically alive. You don’t choose between them. You balance them. ↓ The Gentleman Controlled. Precise. Composed. Inspired by the voice of a British Marshall stack amplifier, this circuit is built for clarity, articulation, and authority. It doesn’t rush, and it doesn’t overwhelm—it arranges your tone. Every note sits exactly where it should, with a sense of structure that feels intentional rather than aggressive. Chords remain defined even under gain. Single notes cut through with purpose. Dynamics stay intact, responding naturally to your playing without losing their shape. The King Bold. Expressive. Uncompromising. Inspired by the most iconic vintage Fuzz ce circuits, this voice is alive, reactive, and unapologetically expressive. It does not aim for perfection—it embraces personality. Every nuance of your playing becomes part of the sound itself, from soft dynamics to aggressive attack. Roll your guitar volume back and it cleans up beautifully, almost whispering. Push it harder and it responds instantly—thick, saturated, and harmonically rich, with a voice that feels almost vocal in character. When both sides are present, Sir Fuzzington becomes something more than two circuits. It becomes a conversation between structure and expression. One side gives your tone its foundation. The other gives it its voice. And between them, you are free to decide how composed — or how untamed — you want to be. Refined by day. Unruly by night.
